description: Positional bias (pairwise-only): each trial is the SAME candidate pair shown in both orders (AB and BA). A fair pairwise judge picks the same underlying better candidate regardless of order; a position-biased judge picks whichever candidate is shown first, so the two orderings disagree and are resolved as a tie (order-swap-and-tie).
